notes: 'all the fortified cities of Judah': the phrase's single the goes to the present article on the attributive הַבְּצֻרוֹת (rule 47), not to the construct.

לְעִיר וָעִיר → 'city by city' writes a word for each occurrence, so rule 22's distributive fusion does not apply; by is given to the waw under rule 14's open list and the distributive לְ is unrepresented. The competing reading gives by to the לְ as the distributive preposition and leaves the waw unrepresented; either is defensible.
